diagnostics.scope: Descriptive retained-trace diagnostics after completed evaluation. Similarity is not calibrated confidence. Position counts and five-region comparisons against each retained appearance exclude repeated work from resume, verification and replay. No fresh tuning or changed qualification rules.

lock.scope: Production, scorer, controls, UI, source selection and actual-app harness frozen before fresh pixels/annotations. Donors are independently audited full views; evaluation cannot train references. Default and source/outcome checks retained.

sources.sourceReview: All 240 selected original images were reviewed before predictions on ten numbered contact sheets. Twelve full-resolution images checked: FaceOcc2 77–80 and 88–91; Walking2 26,60,96,120. FaceOcc2: the face remains visible, with a book covering its lower portion during81–89; small boundary contact77–80 and90 is uncertain. No full disappearance occurs in the fixed120-image source interval. Walking2: the foreground target remains unobstructed while receding in a corridor with other people. Two independently source-marked competitor rectangles are supplied at four evaluation frames26,60,96,120 only; no interpolation, exhaustive distractor labelling or named-person identity claim. Source rectangles come from OTB; visibility and competitor rectangles are separate AI source-only review, not independent human adjudication. Generated controls supply separate exact occlusion/copy geometry. No complete-camera-occlusion qualification or source replacement is claimed.
limitations: Bounded source windows, not a full benchmark.

validation: Local checks passed: 333 distinct Java tests, 161 desktop checks, kernel integration, actual agency regression and isolated offline/package preparation. Three separate donor runs and 20 evaluation runs use 1036 evaluation-frame outcomes; donor outcomes are counted separately. Exact monitor equivalence, original-pixel audit replay, independent host arithmetic, export, stop/resume and abrupt-process cold restart are verified.
